name: kernelcad
description: Create and edit dimensioned parametric manufacturing CAD parts and assemblies from natural-language prompts. Run revision-bound manufacturing-readiness reviews and evidence-backed design trade studies; inspect interactive models; check supported geometry, tolerances, structures, and manufacturability; and export STEP, STL, 3MF, DXF or PDF drawings. For schematics, export connectivity netlists and run electrical rule checks (ERC).
